declarations.name: exists_separable_witness
declarations.doc: Algebraic ⟹ a separable witness with nonzero derivative at the root** (blueprint steps 1–2, abstract core). For `g` algebraic over a char-0 field `K`, its minimal polynomial `q` is separable, so `g` is a SIMPLE root: `aeval g q = 0` and `aeval g (derivative q) ≠ 0`. Applied to `g = φ_c`, `K = ℂ(z)`, this is what feeds `analyticGerm_ne_zero_zeros_countable` (the value-germ `∂_Y q(φ_c) ≠ 0`) and then `AlgebraicBranch.exists_analyticAt_branch`.

declarations.name: exists_separable_fibre_witness_of_separable_over_field
declarations.doc: The separable-fibre witness producer (A3 core).** Suppose the reassembled bivariate relation `P ∈ ℂ[z,Y][X]` is separable over the fraction field `ℂ(z,Y)` (the irreducible/minimal case) and has positive `X`-degree, and let `γ` be a function agreeing with `φ_{c₂}` on `U`, where `φ_{c₂}` is transcendental over `ℂ(z)` (`hG`). Then there is a point `w ∈ U ∖ K_{c₂}` at which the leading coefficient survives and the specialized fibre `∑_{i∈s} Qᵢ(w,γ w)·Xⁱ` (with `Qᵢ = P.coeff i`, `s = P.support`) is separable. The nonzero bivariate polynomial `P.leadingCoeff · (∂P).leadingCoeff · Res(P,∂P) ∈ ℂ[z,Y]` (`resultant_ne_zero_of_separable`) cannot vanish along `Y = φ_{c₂}` by transcendence, giving `w`; at `w` all three factors survive, so `separable_specialize_ringHom` yields separability of the specialization, and `map_bivarPoly_eval₂` rewrites it as a `fibrePoly`.
